summary: The sacrifice ritual at the Crooked Tree (plan 5.7 and 13.11, G5; story/sacrifice_ritual.gd). Each hero offers something of value at the goat skull and rolls a d20 in the open, adding the offering's `bonus`; Kehlenn spends Ritual Points to pull a roll under the `dc`, at most `caps[difficulty]` on one roll. Her points are `base_points` plus what the party's Sin gives her (data/ritual/sin.json). A refused offering stays with its hero, who must offer again; `max_refusals` refusals and the ritual fails. Heroic Inspiration rerolls a refused d20 once. A hero who gives their life (the Last Act) is accepted without a roll. A hero who fell in the fight still offers as a lingering spirit, but can't give a life already gone. The numbers are ours: with these, a simulation of four heroes offering the cheapest first (inspiration half the time) keeps everyone alive about 42% of the time uncapped, 52% at Balanced's cap of 5 and 72% at Story's 3, near the plan's 41% and 53%; check them against the finale digest.
